title: Rest
description: Distribute 20 energy per living player evenly among everyone who picks this card.

title: Eat Rations
description: Distribute 20 food per living player evenly among everyone who picks this card.

title: Expedition
description: Success: gain 40 food and 40 energy. Failure: suffer 1 radiation. Odds: living players / 5.

title: Decontamination
description: If only you pick it, clear all your radiation. If multiple pick it, it cancels. Clean visitors receive 1 radiation even if cancelled.

title: Radiation Shield
description: Block the next incoming radiation hit. Persists until triggered; does not stack.

title: Reinforced Suit
description: Negate the next round-end radiation damage. Does not remove radiation. Persists until triggered; does not stack.

title: Recycle · Food
description: Pay 15 energy to gain 15 food.

title: Recycle · Energy
description: Pay 15 food to gain 15 energy.

title: Sabotage
description: Drain up to 20 food from another player. Mutual sabotage cancels both attacks.

title: Supply Theft
description: Steal up to 30 food from the player with the most food who is not stealing. Multiple thieves split the loot.

title: Dust Storm
description: 60% chance: gain 45 energy. Failure: lose 10 food or 10 energy at random.

title: Ice Cave
description: 60% chance: gain 55 food. Failure: lose 15 health in a cave-in.

title: All In
description: Pay 15 energy. 50% chance: gain 65 food and 20 energy. Failure: cost is not refunded.

title: Mysterious Signal
description: 65% chance: find 35 food and 35 energy. Failure: receive 1 radiation.

title: Supply Exchange
description: Participants swap their food and energy reserves in a random rotation. Does nothing if only one player joins.

title: Contagion
description: If irradiated, add 1 radiation to a clean player. You keep yours. No effect if the target is already contaminated.

title: Emergency Drop
description: Gain 35 food and 35 energy, but suffer 1 radiation. Every participant receives these amounts.

title: Nuclear Cell
description: Gain 45 reserve energy, but suffer 1 radiation from thermal leakage.

title: Solar Flare Harvest
description: Harvest 55 energy from the solar storm, but suffer 1 radiation.

title: Crater Excavation
description: 65% chance: gain 55 food. Failure: suffer 1 radiation and lose 10 health.

title: Isotope Leak
description: Add 1 radiation to another player and recover 15 core energy.
